mapper.select:
select op.id AS policyId, oi.id AS optionItemId, oi.add_price AS extraPrice, oi.sold_out AS isSoldOut
from menu_opt_policy mop join opt_policy op on mop.policy_id = op.id
join opt_policy_item opi on op.id = opi.policy_id
join opt_item oi on opi.opt_item_id = oi.id
where mop.menu_id = #{menuId} and oi.id = #{optionItemId}

select op.id AS policyId, op.min_select AS minSelect, op.max_select AS maxSelect, (mop.required = 1 OR op.required = 1) AS isRequired from menu_opt_policy mop join opt_policy op on mop.policy_id = op.id where mop.menu_id = #{menuId}

select cc.id
from common_code cc
join code_group cg on cc.code_grp_id = cg.id
where cg.group_code = 'ORDER_TYPE' and cc.code = #{code}

select cc.id
from common_code cc
join code_group cg on cc.code_grp_id = cg.id
where cg.group_code = 'ORDER_STATUS' and cc.code = #{code}
select order_no from orders where order_no >= concat(#{orderNoPrefix}, '000001') and order_no <= concat(#{orderNoPrefix}, '999999') order by order_no desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into orders ( order_no, order_type_id, status_id, total_price, created_at ) values ( #{orderNo}, #{orderTypeId}, #{statusId}, #{totalAmount}, now() )

insert into order_item( order_id, menu_id, quantity, price
)values( #{orderId}, #{menuId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice} )

insert into order_item_option( order_item_id, opt_item_id, quantity, price
)values( #{orderItemId}, #{optionItemId}, #{quantity}, #{extraPrice} )
